sn35.243:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Sakkesu viharati Kapilavatthusmiṃ Nigrodhārāme || || 2
sn35.243:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Kāpilavatthavānaṃ Sakyānaṃ navaṃ santhāgāram acirakāritaṃ hoti anajjhāvuṭṭhaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā kenaci vā manussabhūtena || || 3
sn35.243:1.3: Atha kho Kāpilavatthavā Sakyā yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || || 4 Ekam antaṃ nisinnā kho Kāpilavatthavā Sakyā Bhagavantam etad avocuṃ || ||
sn35.243:1.4: Idha bhante Kāpilavatthavānaṃ Sakyānam navaṃ santhāgāram acirakāritam anajjhāvutthaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā kenaci vā manussabhūtena ||
sn35.243:1.6: Bhagavatā pathamam paribhuttam pacchā Kāpilavatthavā Sakyā paribhuñjissanti ||
sn35.243:1.7: tad assa Kāpilavatthavānaṃ Sakyānam dīgharattam hitāya sukhāyāti ||
sn35.243:2.1: Atha kho Kāpilavatthavā Sakyā Bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena navaṃ santhāgāraṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā sabbasanthariṃ santhāgāraṃ santharitvā āsanāni paññāpetvā udakamaṇikam patiṭṭhāpetvā telappadīpam āropetvā yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam etad avocuṃ || || Sabbasanthariṃ
sn35.243:2.2: santhatam bhante santhāgāram āsanāni paññattāni udakamaṇiko patiṭṭhāpito || telappadīpo āropito ||
sn35.243:2.4: Atha kho Bhagavā nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya saddhim bhikkhusaṅghena yena navaṃ santhāgāraṃ tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā pāde pakkhāletvā santhāgāram pavisitvā majjhimam thambhaṃ nissāya puratthābhimukho nisīdi ||
sn35.243:2.5: Bhikkhusaṅgho pi kho pāde pakkhāletvā santhāgāram pavisitvā pacchimam bhittiṃ nissāya puratthābhimukho nisīdi Bhagavantaṃ yeva purakkhatvā || ||
sn35.243:2.6: Kāpilavatthavā pi kho Sakyā pāde pakkhāletvā santhāgāram pavisitvā puratthimam bhittiṃ nissāya pacchāmukhā nisīdiṃsu || Bhagavantaṃ yeva purakkhatvā || 7
sn35.243:2.7: Atha kho Bhagavā Kāpilavatthave Sakye bahudeva rattim dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādāpetvā samuttejitvā sampahaṃsetvā uyyojesi || ||
sn35.243:2.10: Evam bhante ti kho Kāpilavatthavā Sakyā Bhagavato paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkamiṃsu || || 8
sn35.243:3.1: Atha kho Bhagavā acirapakkantesu Kāpilavatthavesu Sakyesu āyasmantam Mahā-Moggalānam āmantesi || ||
sn35.243:3.6: Evam bhante ti kho āyasmā Mahā-Moggalāno Bhagavato paccassosi || 9
sn35.243:3.7: Atha kho Bhagavā catuguṇam saṅghātim paññāpetvā dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappesi || pāde pādam accādhāya sato sampajaño uṭṭhānasaññam manasi karitvā || || 10
sn35.243:3.8: Tatra kho āyasmā Mahā-Moggalāno bhikkhū āmantesi
sn35.243:3.10: Āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Mahā-Moggalānassa paccassosuṃ || ||
sn35.243:3.12: ca vo āvuso desissāmi anavassutapariyāyaṃ ca ||
sn35.243:3.13: taṃ suṇātha sādhukam manasi karotha bhāsissāmīti || ||
sn35.243:3.14: Evam āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Mahā-Moggalānassa paccassosuṃ || ||
sn35.243:4.2: Idhāvuso bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe adhimuccati || apiyarūpe rūpe vyāpajjati || anupaṭṭhitakāyasatī viharati parittacetaso ||
sn35.243:4.3: tañca cetovimuttim paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtam nappajānāti || yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti || la ||
sn35.243:4.5: Manasā dhammaṃ viññāya piyarūpe dhamme adhimuccati apiyarūpe dhamme vyāpajjati || anupaṭṭhitakāyasati viharati parittacetaso ||
sn35.243:4.6: tañ ca cetovimuttim paññavimuttiṃ yathā bhuttaṃ nappajānāti || yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti || 12
sn35.243:4.7: Ayaṃ vuccati āvuso bhikkhu avassuto cakkhuviññeyesu rūpesu || gha ||
sn35.243:4.10: Evaṃ vihāriṃ cāvuso bhikkhuṃ cakkhuto ce pi naṃ Māro upasaṅkamati labhateva Māro otāram labhati Māro ārammaṇam || la ||
sn35.243:4.11: Jivhāto ce pi naṃ Māro upasaṅkamati labhateva Māro otāraṃ labhati Māro ārammaṇaṃ || la ||
sn35.243:4.12: Maṇato ce pi nam Māro upasaṅkamati labhateva Māro otāram labhati Māro ārammaṇaṃ || || 13
sn35.243:5.1: Seyyathāpi āvuso naḷāgāraṃ vā tiṇāgāraṃ vā sukkham kolāpaṃ terovassikam ||
sn35.243:5.2: puratthimāya ce pi naṃ disāya puriso ādittāya tiṇukkāya upasaṅkameyya labhetheva aggi otāraṃ labhetha aggi ārammaṇaṃ ||
sn35.243:5.3: pacchimāya ce pi disāya puriso ādittāya tiṇukkāya upasaṅkameyya || la ||
sn35.243:5.8: yato kutoci ce pi nam puriso ādittāya tiṇukkāya upasaṅkameyya labhetheva aggi otāraṃ labhetha aggi ārammaṇaṃ || ||
sn35.243:5.9: Evam eva kho āvuso evaṃ vihāriṃ bhikkhuṃ cakkhuto ce pi nam Māro upasaṅkamati labhateva Māro otāram labhati Māro ārammaṇaṃ || la ||
sn35.243:5.10: Jivhāto ce pi naṃ Māro upasaṅkamati ||
sn35.243:5.11: Manato ce pi nam Māro upasaṅkamati labhateva Māro otāraṃ labhati Māro ārammaṇaṃ || || 14
sn35.243:5.12: Evaṃ vihāriṃ cāvuso bhikkhuṃ rūpā adhibhaṃsu na bhikkhu rūpe adhibhosi ||
sn35.243:5.13: saddā bhikkhum adhibhaṃsu na bhikkhu sadde adhibhosi ||
sn35.243:5.14: gandhā bhikkhum adhibhaṃsu na bhikkhu gandhe adhibhosi ||
sn35.243:5.15: rasā bhikkhum adhibhaṃsu na bhikkhu rase adhibhosi ||
sn35.243:5.16: phoṭṭhabbā bhikkhum adhibhaṃsu na bhikkhu phoṭṭhabbe adhibhosi ||
sn35.243:5.17: dhammā bhikkhum adhibhaṃsu na bhikkhu dhamme adhibhosi || ||
sn35.243:5.18: Ayaṃ vuccatāvuso bhikkhu rūpādhibhūto saddādhibhūto gandhādhibhūto rasādhibhūto phoṭṭhabbādhibhūto dhammādhibhūto adhibhūto anadhibhū || adhibhaṃsu naṃ pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṅkilesikā ponobhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatijarāmaraṇiyā || ||
sn35.243:6.2: Idhāvuso bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe nādhimuccati apiyarūpe rūpe na vyāpajjati || upaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati appamāṇacetaso ||
sn35.243:6.3: tañca cetovimuttim paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtam pajānāti yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti || pa ||
sn35.243:6.5: Manasā dhammaṃ viññāya pīyarūpe dhamme nādhimuccati apīyarūpe dhamme na vyāpajjati || upaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati appamāṇacetaso ||
sn35.243:6.6: tañca cetovimuttim paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtam pajānāti yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti || ||
sn35.243:6.7: Ayaṃ vuccatāvuso bhikkhu anavassuto cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu || la ||
sn35.243:6.9: Evaṃ vihāriṃ cāvuso bhikkhuṃ cakkhuto ce pi naṃ Māro upasaṅkamati neva labhati Māro otāraṃ na labhati Māro ārammanaṃ || pa ||
sn35.243:6.10: Jivhāto ce pi nam Māro upasaṅkamati || la ||
sn35.243:6.11: Manato ce pi nam Māro upasaṅkamati neva labhati Māro otāram na labhati Māro ārammaṇaṃ || || 16
sn35.243:7.1: Seyyathāpi āvuso kuṭāgāraṃ vā kuṭāgārasālā vā bahalamattikā addāvalepanā ||
sn35.243:7.2: puratthimāya ce pi naṃ disāya puriso ādittāya tiṇukkāya upasaṅkameyya neva labhetha aggi otāraṃ na labhetha aggi ārammaṇam || la ||
sn35.243:7.8: yato kuto ci ce pi nam puriso ādittāya tiṇukkāya upasaṅkameyya neva labhetha aggi otāram na labhetha aggi ārammaṇaṃ || ||
sn35.243:7.9: Evam eva kho āvuso evaṃviharim bhikkhum cakkhuto ce pi nam Māro upasaṅkamati neva labhati Māro otāraṃ na labhati Māro ārammaṇam || pe ||
sn35.243:7.10: manato ce pi nam Māro upasaṅkamati neva labhati Māro otāraṃ na labhati Māro ārammaṇaṃ || 17
sn35.243:7.11: Evaṃ vihārī cāvuso bhikkhu rūpe adhibhosi na rūpā bhikkhum adhibhaṃsu ||
sn35.243:7.12: sadde bhikkhu adhibhosi na saddā bhikkhum adhibhaṃsu ||
sn35.243:7.13: gandhe bhikkhu adhibhosi na gandho bhikkhum adhibhaṃsu ||
sn35.243:7.14: rase bhikkhu adhibhosi na rasā bhikkhum adhibhaṃsu ||
sn35.243:7.15: phoṭṭhabbe bhikkhu adhibhosi na phoṭṭhabbā bhikkhum adhibhaṃsu ||
sn35.243:7.16: dhamme bhikkhu adhibhosi na dhammā bhikkhum adhibhaṃsu || ||
sn35.243:7.17: Ayaṃ vuccatāvuso bhikkhu rupādhibhū saddādhibhū gandhādhibhū rasādhibhū phoṭṭhabbādhibhū dhammādhibhū adhibhū anadhibhūto || adhibhosi te pāpake akusale dhamme saṅkilesike ponobhavike sadare dukkhavipāke āyatijātijarāmaraṇiye || ||
sn35.243:8.1: Atha kho Bhagavā uṭṭhahitvā āyasmantam MahāMoggalānam āmantesi || ||
sn35.243:8.3: sādhu kho tvam Moggalāna bhikkhūnaṃ avassutapariyāyañca anavassutapariyāyañca abhāsīti || || 19
sn35.243:9.3: attamanā te bhikkhū āyasmato Mahā-Moggalānassa bhāsitam abhinandiṃsu || || 3
